name: Fix --dry-run persisting state mutations
goal: Investigate and fix the --dry-run flag in mutating CLI subcommands (expedition create, delete) so it never persists draft files, canonical-state, or event-log entries. Reproducer: two consecutive dry-run and real expedition-create invocations both logged EXPEDITION_CREATED events and persisted draft files (fdc1558fa0a676d7 was an accidental dry-run survivor). Dry-run must be read-only; observability of the intended mutation must come from preview output only.
